app.title: Outbreak Ripple
app.tagline: Small decisions ripple through a district.
app.disclaimer: A teaching simulation of a fictional district. Not a clinical tool; it does not predict real outbreaks. Numbers are illustrative until reviewed.
app.load_failed: The engine could not be loaded.
nav.label: Screens
home.heading: You are the District Health Officer
home.intro: Rash fever, an invented vaccine-preventable illness, is about to arrive. You have one year, six decision turns and a small budget.
briefing.heading: {district} district
briefing.legend: Each tile is a village: reported cases, coverage, trust. A thick border marks a declared outbreak.
briefing.note: You see reported cases only. True numbers appear in the results.
turn.heading: Turn {turn} of {turns}
turn.rules: Play up to {max} cards. Budget {budget}, action points {points}.
feed.heading: What happened
feed.empty: Nothing has been reported yet. Play a turn.
chain.heading: Chain of causes
chain.intro: Open an event to see what caused it. Grey lines mark weaker links: things that may have shifted the event without directly causing it.
results.heading: Results
results.not_ready: Results appear after the last turn.
results.working: Replaying the year without your actions…
results.table_caption: Your run compared with the same year without your actions
results.gap: Coverage gap (best third minus worst third)
results.no_chains: Your actions left no traceable chain this time.
event.infectious.importation: Infection reached {place} from a neighbouring village
event.infectious.outbreak_declared: Outbreak declared in {place} ({cases} cases in two weeks)
event.infectious.herd_threshold_reached: {place} passed the herd immunity threshold ({immune_percent}% immune)
event.systems.cold_chain_failure: Cold chain broke down in {place} block
event.systems.staff_recovered: Staff workload back to normal in {place} block
event.systems.aefi_rumour: A scare about side effects after a session in {place}
event.systems.trust_collapse: Trust in the health team collapses in {place}
event.systems.stock_arrival: Vaccine indent arrives in {place} block ({doses} doses)
event.actions.session_well_timed: The rescheduled session in {place} matched market day
event.actions.session_clash: The rescheduled session in {place} clashed with a local event
event.actions.press_note_calms: The press note calmed the district
event.actions.press_note_backfires: The press note was misread; alarm in {villages} villages
event.actions.inspection_resented: Inspection resented in {place} block; staff staying away
event.actions.line_list_completed: Line list completed in {place}: {cases} pending case(s) reported

results.chain_note: Each list starts with your card. Only events that did not happen in the baseline are shown; steps in between that happened either way are left out.
